question: For each pizza order, provide a single result row with the row ID, order ID, customer ID, pizza name, and final set of ingredients. The final ingredients are determined by starting with the standard toppings from the pizza’s recipe, removing any excluded toppings, and adding any extra toppings. Present the ingredients in a string starting with the pizza name followed by ': ', with ingredients listed in alphabetical order. Ingredients appearing multiple times (e.g., from standard and extra toppings) should be prefixed with '2x' and listed first, followed by single-occurrence ingredients, both in alphabetical order. Group by row ID, order ID, pizza name, and order time to ensure each order appears once. Sort results by row ID in ascending order. Assign pizza_id 1 to 'Meatlovers' pizzas and pizza_id 2 to all others.
sql:
WITH orders AS (
    SELECT 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY order_id, pizza_id, customer_id) as row_id,
        order_id,
        customer_id,
        pizza_id,
        exclusions,
        extras,
        order_time
    FROM pizza_customer_orders
),
standard_toppings AS (
    SELECT 
        o.row_id,
        o.order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        o.pizza_id,
        CAST(TRIM(UNNEST(SPLIT(r.toppings, ','))) AS INTEGER) as topping_id
    FROM orders o
    JOIN pizza_recipes r ON o.pizza_id = r.pizza_id
),
exclusions AS (
    SELECT 
        o.row_id,
        CAST(TRIM(UNNEST(SPLIT(o.exclusions, ','))) AS INTEGER) as exclusion_id
    FROM orders o
    WHERE o.exclusions IS NOT NULL AND o.exclusions != ''
),
extras AS (
    SELECT 
        o.row_id,
        CAST(TRIM(UNNEST(SPLIT(o.extras, ','))) AS INTEGER) as extra_id
    FROM orders o
    WHERE o.extras IS NOT NULL AND o.extras != ''
),
all_toppings AS (
    SELECT 
        st.row_id,
        st.order_id,
        st.customer_id,
        st.pizza_id,
        st.topping_id
    FROM standard_toppings st
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM exclusions e 
        WHERE e.row_id = st.row_id AND e.exclusion_id = st.topping_id
    )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        o.row_id,
        o.order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        o.pizza_id,
        e.extra_id as topping_id
    FROM orders o
    JOIN extras e ON o.row_id = e.row_id
),
topping_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        row_id,
        order_id,
        customer_id,
        pizza_id,
        topping_id,
        COUNT(*) as cnt
    FROM all_toppings
    GROUP BY row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, topping_id
),
topping_names AS (
    SELECT 
        tc.row_id,
        tc.order_id,
        tc.customer_id,
        tc.pizza_id,
        tc.topping_id,
        tc.cnt,
        t.topping_name,
        CASE WHEN tc.cnt > 1 THEN '2x' || t.topping_name ELSE t.topping_name END as display_name,
        CASE WHEN tc.cnt > 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END as sort_group
    FROM topping_counts tc
    JOIN pizza_toppings t ON tc.topping_id = t.topping_id
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT 
        tn.row_id,
        tn.order_id,
        tn.customer_id,
        tn.pizza_id,
        pn.pizza_name,
        string_agg(tn.display_name, ', ' ORDER BY tn.sort_group, tn.topping_name) as ingredients
    FROM topping_names tn
    JOIN pizza_names pn ON tn.pizza_id = pn.pizza_id
    GROUP BY tn.row_id, tn.order_id, tn.customer_id, tn.pizza_id, pn.pizza_name
)
SELECT 
    row_id,
    pizza_name || ': ' || ingredients as FINAL_INGREDIENTS
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY row_id
